latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of automated job application assistant.

- Searches multiple job boards and URLs, filters listings, and deduplicates applications.
- Composes and sends personalized application emails with CV attached via Gmail SMTP.
- Maintains and updates an applications tracker (Applications.json) including status for each job.
- First three applications require user approval (review mode); subsequent applications send automatically.
- Session summary and email/application status updates provided at the end of each run.
